metadata.name: a230-mobile-visible-title
metadata.description: Require a compact reference work block to show its readable title, start time, and duration on a narrow Today viewport; capture the rendered mobile state without business writes.

metadata.label: Open Today under the routed reference-scale lease
Wait for the seeded reference work timeline block

evaluate.expression: (() => { const visible=e=>{if(!e?.isConnected)return false;const s=getComputedStyle(e),r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return s.display!=='none'&&s.visibility!=='hidden'&&Number(s.opacity)!==0&&r.width>0&&r.height>0&&r.bottom>0&&r.top<innerHeight&&r.right>0&&r.left<innerWidth}; const block=[...document.querySelectorAll('.day-plan .time-block.compact')].find(e=>e.dataset.fullTitle?.startsWith('P1 Reference work ')&&visible(e)); if(!block) throw new Error('Reference work compact block is not visible on mobile'); const title=block.querySelector('.time-block-title'),duration=block.querySelector('.time-block-duration'),time=block.querySelector('.time-block-time'); if(!title||!new RegExp('^P1 Reference work [0-9]{4}$').test(title.textContent.trim())||!visible(title)) throw new Error('Mobile work title is not visibly rendered'); if(!duration||!visible(duration)||!new RegExp('^[0-9]+m$').test(duration.textContent.trim())) throw new Error('Mobile compact duration is not visibly rendered'); if(!time||!visible(time)) throw new Error('Mobile start time is not visibly rendered'); return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},title:title.textContent.trim(),title_visible:true,duration:duration.textContent.trim(),duration_visible:true,start_time:time.textContent.trim(),start_time_visible:true,block_rect:(()=>{const r=block.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height}})()}; })()

metadata.label: Require the expected rendered block state
